textbookBox.concept: Karma Yoga is doing our work with honesty, love and effort without expecting a reward. Jadav Molai Payeng planted trees on a bare sandbar in Majuli, Assam, after seeing snakes die without shade.

beats.en: Karma Yoga is doing our work with honesty, love and effort without expecting a reward. Jadav Molai Payeng planted trees on a bare sandbar in Majuli, Assam, after seeing snakes die without shade.
beats.speakEn: Karma Yoga is doing our work with honesty, love and effort without expecting a reward. Jadav Molai Payeng planted trees on a bare sandbar in Majuli, Assam, after seeing snakes die without shade.

beats.en: Gyana Yoga is the path of knowledge, curiosity and asking questions. Swami Chinmayananda is regarded as a great Gyana yogi of modern times.
